user.title: Nokia FastMile 4G
user.description: Address of the receiver's web interface. The installer account is optional: it is only needed for the Reboot button.

data_description.host: IP address of the receiver, usually 192.168.0.1.
data_description.username: Usually fm2-installer. Leave empty if you do not need the Reboot button.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the modem. Check the address and that Home Assistant can route to it.
error.invalid_response: The address answered, but it does not look like a Nokia FastMile status page.
error.invalid_auth: The modem rejected the installer username or password.
error.credentials_incomplete: Enter both username and password, or neither.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two reads of the status page.
data_description.username: Needed for the Reboot button. Leave both fields empty to remove it.

error.invalid_auth: The modem rejected the installer username or password.
error.credentials_incomplete: Enter both username and password, or neither.
